stories.title: CityUHK develops infrared-transparent aerogel for passive cooling
stories.summary: Researchers at City University of Hong Kong have developed a white infrared-transparent aerogel designed to boost passive cooling performance by up to 5.2 degrees Celsius. The team aims to address rising energy consumption and carbon emissions caused by the increased use of air conditioning globally.

stories.title: Bihar Green Conclave 2026 discusses sustainable urban growth
stories.summary: The Confederation of Indian Industry and the Indian Green Building Council hosted the Bihar Green Conclave 2026 in Patna. Stakeholders gathered to discuss green buildings, climate-resilient infrastructure, and sustainable industrial growth under the theme of creating a green trillion for the state of Bihar.

stories.title: Green-certified office leasing expected to dominate Indian market
stories.summary: Colliers India reports that leasing in green-certified office assets across India's top seven markets is expected to reach 65 million square feet in 2026. This would account for 85 per cent of total leasing, up from 76 per cent in 2025. Buildings are chasing certifications to remain relevant.

stories.title: Green office leasing in India set to cross 80% in 2026: Colliers
stories.summary: Eco-friendly office spaces are becoming the preferred choice for companies in India, with their share in total office leasing across the country’s top seven cities expected to cross 80 per cent in 2026, as businesses increasingly focus on sustainability and energy efficiency, according to a

stories.title: Eco-friendly offices become new corporate preference, green leasing to cross 80% in 2026: Report
stories.summary: Eco-friendly office spaces are becoming the preferred choice for companies in India, with their share in total office leasing across the country's top seven cities expected to cross 80 per cent in 2026, as businesses increasingly focus on sustainability and energy efficiency, according to a

stories.title: REC office building in Gurugram receives 5-star GRIHA rating
stories.summary: REC Limited has been awarded a 5-star GRIHA rating for its office building in Gurugram. The rating, the highest under the framework, acknowledges the company's efforts in sustainable design, energy efficiency, and resource optimisation. The award was presented at the 18th GRIHA Summit in New Delhi.

stories.title: Companies launch pilot for recyclable wind turbine blades
stories.summary: Grasim Industries, Suzlon Energy, and Aditya Birla Renewables have partnered to develop and commercialise recyclable wind turbine blades. The companies will launch a pilot project at an Aditya Birla site to assess the technology, aiming to address the end-of-life waste problem inherent in current wind energy infrastructure.

stories.summary: New Delhi, November 4: REC Limited’s office building in Gurugram has received the highest 5-Star rating under the GRIHA (Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment) framework for its sustainable building practices. The recognition was conferred at the 18th GRIHA Summit in New Delhi on November

stories.summary: New Delhi: REC Limited, a Maharatna public sector enterprise under the Ministry of Power, has received the highest 5-Star rating under the Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment (GRIHA) framework for its office building in Gurugram. The recognition acknowledges REC’s efforts in sustainable building design,

The company’s office building in Gurugram has received the highest 5-Star GRIHA Rating, recognising its efforts in sustainable building design, energy

stories.title: NBCC World Trade Centre project receives provisional 4-star rating
stories.summary: The National Buildings Construction Corporation has been awarded a provisional 4-star GRIHA rating for its World Trade Centre project in New Delhi. The rating assesses the building's performance across sustainability criteria, including environmental impact and energy use. GRIHA is the country's national rating system for green buildings.

stories.title: 3 Indian design practices making a statement through facade design
stories.summary: Facade design extends beyond a building’s external appearance. Material, form and construction shape how a structure responds to its surroundings, accommodates its programme, is experienced and develops its architectural identity. From weather-responsive materials to parametric metal screens and layered elevations, three AD PRO Directory partners

stories.title: Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt’s staggering real estate portfolio in Mumbai and beyond
stories.summary: As Ranbir Kapoor steps into the role of Lord Rama in Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana, one of the most anticipated films of the year, the actor is also building a life that extends well beyond the film sets. Away from the scale of the mythological epic,

stories.title: India proposes world's highest railway station in Ladakh
stories.summary: India is planning a 489-km railway corridor connecting Bilaspur to Leh at an estimated cost of 1.31 lakh crore rupees. The project includes a station at 5,256 metres above sea level, which would surpass China's current record for the world's highest railway station.

stories.title: Supreme Court permits conveyance deeds for Parsvnath homebuyers
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has authorised the execution of conveyance deeds for homebuyers in completed Parsvnath Developers projects. The ruling follows legal proceedings regarding the company's insolvency and mandates the release of funds for project expenses, providing relief to buyers who have waited years for their homes.

stories.title: Mahindra Lifespaces enters plotted development market in Mumbai
stories.summary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers has signed a 100-acre plotted development project on the Karjat-Murbad Road in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This marks the company's first plotted development project outside of its existing operations in Chennai. The launch is scheduled for the next financial year.

stories.title: ILV South Warehousing Parks acquires 47-acre industrial site near Bengaluru
stories.summary: ILV South Warehousing Parks has acquired a 47-acre industrial land parcel in Kolar for a total premium of 105.47 crore. The land was allotted by the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board through a lease-cum-sale arrangement. The transaction covers a ten-year period for the industrial site.

stories.title: Mahindra Lifespace Developers plans 100-acre project in Mumbai region
stories.summary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers has signed a 100-acre plotted development project in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This marks the company's first project of this type in the area, following similar developments in Chennai. The firm cites growing interest in plotted projects as the driver for this expansion.

stories.title: NLMC puts HIL land in Delhi up for auction at 830 crore
stories.summary: The National Land Monetisation Corporation has initiated an e-auction for a 5.119-acre land parcel in Delhi owned by HIL. The reserve price is set at 829.69 crore. This is the third such auction in two months as the government continues to monetise surplus public sector assets.

stories.title: Agartala slum residents receive new flats after eight-year wait
stories.summary: A total of 278 families living in a slum along the Haora river have received flats in the Agartala Light House Project. The allocation follows an eight-year wait for the residents. The project plans to eventually provide 1,000 flats across seven buildings at a cost of 162.50 crore.

stories.title: Mhada proposes price cuts on unsold Mumbai apartments
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Authority has proposed reducing prices by up to 10 percent on hundreds of unsold Mumbai flats. The inventory includes units overlooking the sea and the Kanjurmarg landfill. The revised rates would apply to units sold under the First Come First Serve scheme.

stories.title: PCPL launches mixed-use tower in Oshiwara with 430 crore value
stories.summary: Pranav Constructions has launched the I/O Tower and I/O Residences in Goregaon with a combined gross development value of nearly 430 crore. The project replaces a former co-operative housing society. It aims to combine boutique office spaces and residential units within a single landmark development.

stories.title: Linehouse completes industrial-themed hotel interiors in Hangzhou
stories.summary: Architecture studio Linehouse has finished the interiors for the Jen hotel in Hangzhou, China. The 18-floor building, designed by Kohn Pedersen Fox, uses steel and grey brick to reference the site's industrial history. The interior design extends this approach to reflect the area's local craft and heritage.

stories.title: Monograph documents 15 years of OODA architecture
stories.summary: Hatje Cantz has published a monograph titled Some Kind of Romance, Any Kind of Existence, detailing 15 years of work by the Porto-based studio OODA. The book is divided into two parts, framing the firm's projects through a dialogue between past and future work and architectural memory.

stories.title: Holst Architecture completes Oregon library project
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Holst Architecture has completed the East County Library in Oregon, a community hub designed in collaboration with Adjaye Associates. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: SOM masterplans new Egyptian city with lagoon network
stories.summary: Architecture studio SOM has unveiled a 20.6-square-kilometre masterplan for a city named Alam Al Roum in Egypt. The design features 22 kilometres of seawater-connected lagoons intended to support stormwater management. The project will stretch 7.2 kilometres along the Mediterranean coastline near Marsa Matrouh.

stories.title: Design Doha Biennial 2026 explores traditional craft and urban heat
stories.summary: The Design Doha Biennial 2026 has opened in Qatar, featuring 19 exhibitions and over 80 designers. The event showcases techniques for managing urban heat and runs until 31 January 2027. The historic Fereej Al Asmakh neighbourhood serves as the primary venue for the contemporary design showcase.

stories.title: Förstberg Ling completes masonry house in Sweden
stories.summary: Architects Förstberg Ling have completed a 150-square-metre house in a small Swedish village. The project consists of a traditional masonry volume with a gable roof and an attached circular garden. The design was required to adhere to strict local site regulations.

stories.title: Belmopan's history as a planned capital city
stories.summary: Belize's capital, Belmopan, was established as a planned city to replace the former capital and provide institutional stability against hurricanes. The city was developed as the territory transitioned toward independence from British rule, serving as a symbol of the nation's emerging identity.

stories.title: SPACE | STORY | STUDIO designs flexible hillside house
stories.summary: The Khao Phra Tamnak House in Thailand is a 2,000-square-metre project designed around a flexible framework rather than a fixed architectural form. The studio integrated land level changes, Feng Shui principles, and the needs of the family into a single, adjustable design diagram.

stories.title: architectureRED examines urban housing identity in India
stories.summary: A project by architectureRED explores the intersection of rapid urbanisation and housing design in India. The firm notes that market-driven pressures often prioritise maximum yield over community and rootedness. The 13,100-square-metre development attempts to address the homogenization of urban environments.

stories.title: Albania's building boom attracts international architects
stories.summary: Albanian prime minister Edi Rama is overseeing a significant architectural expansion in Tirana. The prime minister, a former basketball player and artist, describes architecture as a strong medicine that can heal or kill. Many international architects have contributed to the country's recent building projects.

stories.title: CAAM Arquitectos renovates Mexico City apartment
stories.summary: CAAM Arquitectos has completed the renovation of a 90-square-metre apartment in the Roma Norte neighbourhood of Mexico City. The project, titled Tabasco 267, involved a complete transformation of the layout, lighting, and finishes, using the existing apartment structure as the primary raw material.

stories.title: APAP adds glass and concrete pavilion to 1970s home
stories.summary: Architecture practice APAP has completed a residential extension to a 1970s house in Nicosia, Cyprus. The project, named DIAGONAL, features a cantilevered glass and concrete pavilion. It departs from the original home's load-bearing wall structure by using two horizontal planes to create the new space.

stories.title: Aformic raises $6.95 million for industrial robots
stories.summary: Aformic has raised $6.95 million in seed funding to expand its industrial robot deployments. The company reports its robots have traveled 186,000 miles and complete 5,000 orders daily for clients including Toyota and 3M. It now plans to add more engineering and sales staff to the payroll.

stories.title: Qonic launches AI agents for BIM modelling
stories.summary: Qonic has introduced Qonic AI, a collection of agents built directly into its cloud-based BIM platform. Users can describe tasks in plain language to find, check and update model elements. The company also launched an MCP server to let users connect their own external AI assistants.

stories.title: Holcim acquires Burdett Group in Australia
stories.summary: Holcim has acquired the Burdett Group to expand its aggregates and circular construction footprint in Australia. The company says the purchase fits its NextGen Growth 2030 strategy of investing in attractive markets. Burdett Group is a supplier of recycled construction demolition materials and sand in Melbourne.

stories.title: Mass timber gains traction as costs rise
stories.summary: The use of mass timber is growing as rising construction costs push developers toward more cost-effective materials. Proponents contend that mass timber buildings are often faster and cheaper to erect than steel structures. Economic headwinds and material tariffs are currently driving interest in the strategy.

stories.title: Exeter University tops out Passivhaus student blocks
stories.summary: The University of Exeter and Bouygues UK have topped out two student accommodation blocks built to Passivhaus standards. The project aims for very low operational energy demand and high airtightness. It signals a growing adoption of the standard for multi-storey university buildings in the UK.

stories.title: Precision Resource builds two additive manufacturing sites
stories.summary: Precision Resource has broken ground on two metal additive manufacturing facilities in California and Connecticut. The sites are expected to be operational in the first quarter of 2027, coinciding with the company’s 80th year in business. The California location will double the firm's existing industrial capacity.

stories.title: Washington D.C. launches mass timber accelerator
stories.summary: The Washington Architectural Foundation has launched a program to provide funding and technical assistance for mass timber projects in the District. The accelerator will award $160,000 across several projects to support design work during early development phases. It is supported by the USDA Forest Service.

stories.title: Gadkari says highway signage remains inadequate
stories.summary: Road transport minister Nitin Gadkari stated that Indian highways and expressways still lack proper signage, contributing to the country's 5 lakh annual road accidents. He noted that a world-standard signage policy he prepared was not implemented by the National Highways Authority of India.

stories.title: Shackleton AI raises $5 million for construction agents
stories.summary: Shackleton AI has raised $5 million in seed funding led by Battery Ventures. The company is launching an agentic platform designed to manage the administrative work between construction plans, finances, and field reports. It aims to automate tasks that currently sit between various project communications.

stories.title: Acelab opens material search to public
stories.summary: Acelab has opened its material search hub to the public, allowing architects to access product records without an account. Executive Chairman Dave Lemont, who previously led Revit Technology, stated that connecting material data to every document is the unfinished work of BIM. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: US Army flies hybrid drone with 3D printed engine
stories.summary: The U.S. Army has successfully flown a hybrid electric drone powered by a 3D printed heavy-fuel rotary engine. The engine drives a 400v motor-generator, allowing the aircraft to use denser military fuel while ditching a bulky liquid cooling system. The engine was developed using metal 3D printing.

stories.title: Study links light pollution to protected areas
stories.summary: A new study examines how artificial light at night affects protected areas in Kerala’s Western Ghats. Researchers investigated how illumination from surrounding human settlements, roads and tourism facilities impacts wildlife navigation and predator-prey interactions. The study assessed 21 locations across the region.

stories.title: Energy efficiency in J&K buildings remains low
stories.summary: Buildings in Jammu and Kashmir consume nearly 50% of total energy due to harsh climates and lossy design, compared to 35% nationally. While consumers are familiar with star ratings for appliances, energy efficiency in building construction remains a largely unknown concept in the region.

stories.title: Villagers build bamboo bridge after ferry disputes
stories.summary: Villagers in Malda have constructed a bamboo bridge across the Kalindri River following complaints of harassment and excess charges by a local ferry operator. The district administration has questioned the decision to build the crossing without official permission. The bridge serves thousands of residents.

stories.title: Warehousing rents in NCR jump 44%
stories.summary: Warehousing rents in the National Capital Region have surged 44% since 2023, reaching ₹33 per sq ft per month. The region accounts for 21.8% of India's total warehousing demand. According to ANAROCK, this marks the steepest rental appreciation among the country's eight major markets.

stories.title: Nitin Gadkari flags Indian highways, expressways still lack perfect signage
stories.summary: Addressing an event organised by the economic think tank NCAER and Jana Urban Space Janaagraha, Gadkari said Indian highways and expressways do not have proper signage, which is also responsible for road accidents. "Every road should have proper and clear signage. I had prepared a

stories.title: Construction equipment market projected to grow
stories.summary: The Indian construction equipment market was valued at $15.37 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach $29.50 billion by 2034. Growth is supported by government infrastructure spending, which reached 3.4% of GDP in the 2024-25 budget. The sector faces significant upcoming regulatory changes.

stories.title: Fluke India eyes engineering expansion
stories.summary: Fluke India is looking to expand its engineering capabilities to support growing demand in data centres and semiconductors. Managing Director Jaison Isaac said the firm is exploring local firmware development alongside its existing software work. The company currently employs 203 people in the country.

stories.title: Architects define India-right bathroom design
stories.summary: Nineteen architects met at the Grohe Circle Intellect Forum to discuss the future of Indian bathroom design. The group focused on fittings, wellness, and smart products to create a five-year outlook. The session will culminate in a formal document defining what constitutes an India-right bathroom.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu weakens after landfall
stories.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall near Ongole on November 3 with winds gusting to 120 kmph. The storm has since weakened into a depression over east Telangana and coastal Andhra Pradesh. Heavy rainfall and localised flooding remain concerns as the system moves northwards.

stories.title: REMC and ISA partner on solar storage
stories.summary: RITES subsidiary REMC Ltd has signed a framework agreement with the International Solar Alliance to cooperate on solar energy and battery storage. The partnership aims to develop competency-based training programmes and provide technical support for renewable energy projects. The focus includes both solar power and storage systems.

stories.title: India launches 1.5 billion dollar energy storage plan
stories.summary: India has launched a 1.5 billion dollar scheme to develop 92 gigawatt-hours of energy storage capacity by 2031. The government expects the incentives to trigger 10 billion dollars in investment. The plan adds capacity equal to 170 percent of the country's current grid-scale storage.

stories.title: India announces $1.5-billion scheme to add 92 GWh energy storage capacity
stories.summary: The scheme, which will run from 2026-27 to 2030-31, will support the development of 60 GWh of pumped hydro storage, 30 GWh of battery storage and another 2 GWh using emerging storage technologies. The government expects the incentives to draw around $10 billion in investments

stories.title: India launches US$1.5bil energy storage plan
stories.summary: India is the third-biggest emitter of greenhouse gases and remains deeply dependent on polluting coal to meet its soaring energy demand. Power generation in India, home to more than 1.4 billion people, is expected to continue rising rapidly even as the government pursues its goal

stories.title: Urban heat delays first frost dates
stories.summary: First frost dates for 2026 are based on 1991 to 2020 averages, showing cities often freeze weeks after nearby suburbs. The Weather Company reports that pavement and steel retain enough heat to influence local timing. A location on a map matters less than the surrounding infrastructure.

stories.title: Brazil releases global fossil fuel roadmap
stories.summary: Brazil has produced a voluntary roadmap for transitioning away from fossil fuels, describing the process as urgent and inevitable. The plan asks countries to diagnose their own readiness and pursue tailored levers for action. The document suggests there is no one-size-fits-all approach to the transition.

The article highlights that rapid urban expansion is outpacing governance and

stories.title: Philippine island uses nature to fight rising seas
stories.summary: Residents of Pamarawan Island are using bamboo poles and oyster shells to build wave barriers. The project offers a nature-based alternative to concrete flood-control structures. The island faces land subsidence and rising seas, while the country continues to manage public fury over previous substandard concrete projects.

Existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact also participated, along with strategic angel investors. The startup turns agricultural residue

stories.title: AltM raises 10.3 million dollars for chemicals
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised 10.3 million dollars in a Series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company turns agricultural residue into chemicals to replace fossil-derived inputs. It plans to use the funds to move from pilot-scale production to commercial manufacturing.

stories.title: Cleantech Startup altM Raises $10.3 Mn To Scale Manufacturing
stories.summary: Cleantech startup altM has raised $10.3 Mn (₹97.5 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by new investors Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. Existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact also participated. The Bengaluru-based startup plans to use the fresh capital to

stories.title: Sunday PropTech acquires Kolkata hotel
stories.summary: Sunday PropTech has acquired an 89-room hotel in Kolkata. The full details of the transaction and the company's plans for the property were not disclosed in the provided text. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: LiveX expands AI City hologram capabilities
stories.summary: LiveX has updated its AI City product to include 3D maps and multilingual translation. The system features a life-sized hologram designed to act as a physical host for visitors. The technology was previously deployed at San Jose Mineta International Airport to answer questions from travelers.

stories.title: Sunday PropTech enters Kolkata market
stories.summary: Sunday PropTech has acquired an 89-room hotel in Kolkata to expand its mid-premium hospitality portfolio. The company plans to rebrand the 2017-built property and use its internal technology platform to improve operational performance. The hotel is located near the city's international airport.

stories.title: Harvard student wins James Dyson Award
stories.summary: Radhika Saran, a student at Harvard University, has won the global medical category of the James Dyson Award 2026. She co-developed a low-cost headset that uses infrared eye-tracking technology to screen athletes for potential concussion-related neurological impairment. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Liverpool School of Architecture opens new building
stories.summary: The University of Liverpool has opened a new building for its School of Architecture, featuring virtual reality suites and digital design spaces. The ceremony was led by actor and alumnus Anton Lesser. The facility is intended to provide students with updated teaching and research environments.

stories.title: Architecture department head departs
stories.summary: Peter Baldwin has left his position as head of the architecture department at the University of Liverpool after 15 months. His departure follows a period of staff restructuring and ongoing disputes regarding redundancies. The university has declined to comment on the reasons for his exit.

stories.title: Architecture adapts to remote work
stories.summary: The modern home was originally designed to separate domestic life from professional obligations. Remote work has forced a shift in this arrangement, requiring residential interiors to accommodate professional tasks alongside daily living. The transition has moved from a temporary adjustment to a more permanent fixture of domestic space.

stories.title: Liverpool School of Architecture celebrates new facility
stories.summary: The University of Liverpool has opened a new extension for its architecture school, designed by O’Donnell + Tuomey. The space includes collaborative workspaces and exhibition areas to showcase student work. The school, which was founded in 1894, describes the project as a milestone in its history.

stories.title: MIT architecture dean to step down
stories.summary: Hashim Sarkis will conclude his 12-year tenure as dean of the MIT School of Architecture and Planning in June 2027. His leadership included the conversion of the century-old Met Warehouse into a design hub. The school is now preparing for a leadership transition.

stories.title: Tennessee Tech seeks founding director for new school
stories.summary: Tennessee Tech University is launching a new architecture school and is searching for a founding director. The role requires a visionary architect-educator to lead the accreditation and development of a Bachelor of Architecture program. The position is based in Cookeville, Tennessee.

stories.title: Tennessee Tech is launching an architecture school and looking for a founding director | News | Archinect
stories.summary: Following our previous look at openings for professors at Tulane University, we are using this week’s edition of our Job Highlights series to explore an open role on Archinect Jobs for the Founding Director, School of Architecture at Tennessee Tech University. The role, based in

stories.title: Student invention screens for concussions
stories.summary: Radhika Saran has won the James Dyson Award 2026 for a concussion-screening headset called Rumble Rims. The device uses infrared eye-tracking to help medical personnel identify neurological impairment in athletes. It is intended to provide a low-cost method for making informed decisions on the field.

stories.title: FAU architecture poster earns national recognition
stories.summary: Florida Atlantic University’s architecture lecture series poster has been voted one of the top five in the country for the third consecutive year. The recognition comes from the Archinect Get Lectured series, which highlights graphic communication and public programming at architecture schools across the United States.

stories.title: SRMIST opens applications for 2027
stories.summary: SRMIST has opened applications for its 2027 entrance examinations across multiple disciplines. Available programs include engineering, architecture, law, and medicine. The university is accepting candidates for its various departments, including its business and agricultural science schools.

stories.title: Exeter University completes sustainable campus project
stories.summary: Exeter University has reached financial close on West Park, described as Europe’s largest Passivhaus student accommodation project. The development will provide 1,849 beds using air source heat pumps and solar panels. Phased move-in is scheduled to begin in September 2027, with full occupancy expected by 2028.

research.title: A self-organizing mechanism for collective foraging: recruitment cascades couple Levy search to a clustered maximum-entropy resource field

research.title: AGORA cities: the hidden infrastructure shaping urban fragility
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban services are unevenly distributed across the city, yet it is unclear when their joint presence signals fragility and when it instead outlines a neighbourhood's vocation. For Bologna and Florence, we integrate Foursquare and OpenStreetMap points. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Emergent regularity of walking patterns: evidence from Swiss cities
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Human travel behaviour is characterised by high temporal and spatial regularity, as demonstrated by the Exploration and Preferential Return (EPR) mechanism, whereby individuals alternate between exploring new locations and preferentially returning to previously visited places. Across three online and in-person workshops, 48 residents from Hampshire and London explored. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Limited knowledge exchange across biological subfields in agent-based modelling: an LLM-assisted bibliometric analysis
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent-based models (ABMs) are widely used across the biological sciences. While applications differ between biological subfields, the mathematical and statistical methods underlying ABMs largely do not, raising the question of how much knowledge is exchanged between. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
